articles.title: MUMBAI ACCIDENT: 22-Foot Ganesh Idol Collapses in Mumbai’s Bhuleshwar, Two Devotees Killed, Five Injured
articles.description: A major accident occurred in Mumbai’s Bhuleshwar area during the arrival procession of a Ganesh idol for Ganesh Utsav. The 22-foot-tall idol of “Bhuleshwarcha Raja,” being brought from Byculla to Bhuleshwar, suddenly became unbalanced and collapsed around 50 metres before reaching the pandal. Two devotees caught beneath the falling idol died in the accident. Five others were seriously injured, including two young girls. All the injured were immediately shifted to a nearby hospital for treatment. The incident shocked devotees and people gathered around the procession. Police reached the spot and began assessing the situation. The exact reason why the massive idol became unstable and fell is yet to be established. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the accident.

articles.title: BREAKING NEWS: Three people killed in massive fire in Bakhtiyarpur, Patna
articles.description: A devastating fire broke out at a hardware shop in the Old Bypass area of Bakhtiyarpur, near Patna, Bihar. The flames quickly intensified and spread to the residential portion above the shop, trapping family members inside. Three people, including a six-month-old baby girl and two women, died after being trapped in the blaze. Their bodies were later recovered from the debris and taken to the Bakhtiyarpur Primary Health Centre, where doctors declared them dead. Three other people were rescued from the affected room and suffered serious burn injuries. They were taken to a nearby hospital for treatment. Police personnel and fire brigade teams reached the spot after receiving information from local residents and worked for several hours to bring the fire under control. The exact cause of the fire remains unclear. Authorities are continuing their investigation and are expected to determine the cause after the site is fully examined.

articles.title: Rahul Gandhi’s ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ vs PM Modi’s BJP Team Meet | Pune & Delhi Buzz | News18
articles.description: A busy political day unfolds with Rahul Gandhi’s “Chhatron Ki Goonj” student outreach programme in Pune and Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s first interaction with the BJP’s newly appointed national office-bearers in Delhi.Rahul Gandhi reached Pune on August 22 for the women-focused edition of “Chhatron Ki Goonj”, part of Congress’s wider student outreach campaign. The programme focused on engaging young women and hearing their concerns, with education, equality and social issues among the themes discussed. The event also came amid tensions between ABVP and NSUI members outside COEP University, adding a political edge to Rahul Gandhi’s visit.In Delhi, BJP president Nitin Nabin chaired his first meeting with the party’s newly appointed 65-member national team, with discussions centred on organisational strengthening, grassroots outreach and preparations for upcoming Assembly elections. The new team has 51 new faces, marking the BJP’s biggest organisational reshuffle in more than a decade.Prime Minister Narendra Modi later met the new BJP team at party headquarters and posed for a group photograph with the newly appointed office-bearers.
